Austria U17 vs Italy U17: Watch Live Stream Online - FIFA U-17 World Cup 24.11.2025

It is crunch time in Doha. Two European powerhouses take to the pitch at the Aspire Zone to battle for a spot in the FIFA U-17 World Cup final. On one side stands Austria, pragmatic and unexpectedly dominant; on the other, Italy, the reigning European champions at this level. This promises to be a tactical masterclass where a single mistake could mean heartbreak just steps away from glory.

Date and Kick-off Time: November 24, 2025, 13:30 UTC (16:30 MSK).

Road to the Semi-finals and Team Form

Austria U17 has been the revelation of the tournament in Qatar. The squad has not just reached this stage; they have stormed through it, winning all six matches with an impressive goal difference. In the quarter-finals, the Austrians broke down a resilient Japan (1-0), following comprehensive victories over England (4-0) and New Zealand (4-1). Their main weapon is Johannes Moser. The attacking midfielder has already netted 6 goals, making him the tournament's joint-top scorer. Austria plays vertical football, ruthlessly punishing opponents for any loss of possession.

Italy U17, conversely, has navigated the tournament in classic Azzurri fashion: minimum risk, maximum efficiency. They scraped past Burkina Faso (1-0) in the quarter-finals thanks to a late winner from Thomas Campaniello. Before that, they endured a nervy 3-2 win over Uzbekistan and a solid 2-0 victory against Czechia. Led by captain and defensive stalwart Luca Reggiani, Italy relies on ball control and positional attacks. They know how to 'kill' a game, but today they face an opponent capable of cracking even the tightest defensive lines.

Team News and Head-to-Head

Both teams enter the match with absences that will inevitably impact their tactics. Austria is without Ifeanyi Ndukwe due to suspension - a key component of their setup. Italy will be missing David Marini. This will force the coaches to reshuffle their lineups, potentially simplifying their midfield approach.

History favors the Italians. The Azzurri have won 5 of the 8 meetings between the sides, while Austria has only managed 2 victories. The last time these teams met at the U17 level was in 2019, a match that ended in a draw. However, this current Austrian generation looks more balanced and hungry for success than their predecessors.

Austria U17 vs Italy U17 Prediction

Bookmakers cautiously favor Italy, pointing to their pedigree and status as European champions. However, Austria's current form (6 consecutive wins) suggests the underdogs are more than capable of springing a surprise. Expect a tight, cagey affair with few clear-cut chances, as the stakes are simply too high for open play.

  • Likely Outcome: Italy to advance, possibly in extra time or penalties. Big-match experience should be the deciding factor.
  • Total Goals Bet: 'Under 2.5 Goals'. Both teams possess strong defenses, and the value of a single goal in a semi-final is immense.
  • Key Factor: Whether the Italian defense can shackle Johannes Moser. If they can, Italy will likely book their place in the final.

Tune into the Austria vs Italy live stream on tutsport.net and witness this historic semi-final clash!

Nasaf vs Tractor: Watch Live Stream Online - AFC Champions League Elite 24.11.2025

Round 5 of the AFC Champions League Elite (West Region) sees Uzbekistan's FC Nasaf host Iran's Tractor Sazi at the Markaziy Stadium in Qarshi. This is a pivotal clash for the home side; dropping points could jeopardize their chances of reaching the knockout stage. Tractor, currently enjoying a strong run of form, arrives in Uzbekistan aiming to solidify their position in the top 8.

Date and Kick-off Time: November 24, 2025, 13:45 UTC (16:45 MSK).

Team Form and Match Preview

Nasaf, under the long-term guidance of Ruzikul Berdiev, is traditionally formidable on home soil. The 'Dragons' rely heavily on tactical discipline and physical dominance. Having already secured their objectives in the Uzbekistan Super League, their focus is entirely on the continental stage. In their last three ACL matches, Nasaf conceded only two goals, underlining their reputation as one of the most organized defensive units in the region. However, converting chances against low-block defenses remains a struggle.

Tractor Sazi (Tabriz) is having one of its best seasons in recent memory. The Iranian side boasts a potent attack capable of punishing opponents via set-pieces and swift counter-attacks. In the previous round, Tractor comfortably dispatched a Qatari side, demonstrating tactical versatility. Their weakness lies in away performances under high pressure-exactly the kind of environment Nasaf will look to create from the first whistle.

Head-to-Head History

These teams are no strangers in Asian competition. The record in Qarshi favors the hosts: Nasaf has won 2 of the last 3 home encounters against Tractor. Historically, Iranian clubs struggle in Uzbekistan, often getting bogged down in physical midfield battles. The last meeting ended in a narrow 2-1 victory for Nasaf, though Tractor controlled large periods of that game.

Nasaf vs Tractor Prediction

Bookmakers see this as a tightly contested affair, giving a slight edge to Nasaf due to home advantage. Expect a cagey, tactical game; both teams are acutely aware of the high stakes at this stage of the League Phase. Berdiev is unlikely to take unnecessary risks, while Tractor would likely be satisfied with a draw on a difficult away trip.

  • Likely Outcome: Nasaf to win or Draw (1X). The hosts are incredibly tough to beat at the Markaziy Stadium.
  • Total Goals Bet: Under 2.5 Goals. Given the pragmatic approach of both managers, a high-scoring shootout is improbable.
  • Key Factor: Set-pieces. The match could well be decided by a single corner or free-kick.

Tune into the Nasaf vs Tractor live stream on tutsport.net to watch this crucial Asian football showdown!

Al Duhail vs Al Ittihad: Watch Live Stream Online - AFC Champions League Elite 24.11.2025

The Abdullah bin Khalifa Stadium in Doha hosts the headline fixture of the AFC Champions League Elite matchday. Qatari giants Al Duhail welcome Saudi powerhouse Al Ittihad. This is a classic Gulf derby where tactical rigidity clashes with world-class individual brilliance. For the hosts, a defeat would severely compromise their group standing, while the visitors from Jeddah arrive looking to validate their title credentials.

Date and Kick-off Time: November 24, 2025, 16:00 UTC (19:00 MSK).

Match Preview and Team Form

Al Duhail, managed by Christophe Galtier, is attempting to implement a high-pressing European style. In the Qatar Stars League (QSL), they lead in chances created, yet their conversion rate remains erratic. The main issue for the 'Red Knights' is defensive instability. Against pacey opposition, their backline frequently loses shape, leading to dangerous counter-attacks. At home, they play aggressively, aiming for an early goal to control the tempo.

Al Ittihad appears to be the more mature and balanced unit. The Saudi club boasts one of the strongest squads in Asia. In the current ACL campaign, the 'Tigers' have conceded the fewest goals in the group, relying on ball retention and physical dominance in midfield. Their attacking trio is in peak form, ruthlessly punishing opponents for minor errors. Away from home, Al Ittihad is comfortable absorbing pressure, yet they typically maintain at least 55% possession.

Head-to-Head (H2H) History

The history between these two sides features several iconic battles. The historical advantage lies with the Saudi club, which has won more frequently, particularly in knockout stages. Al Ittihad's last visit to Doha ended in a high-scoring draw. A defining characteristic of their meetings is physical intensity and a high card count-emotions in Gulf derbies often boil over.

Al Duhail vs Al Ittihad Prediction

Despite Al Duhail's home advantage, bookmakers give a slight edge to the visitors. The individual quality of Al Ittihad's roster is superior, and their ability to kill off games could be the deciding factor. The Qataris will be forced to take risks, leaving spaces for the visitors' lethal counter-attacks.

  • Likely Outcome: Al Ittihad to Win or Draw (X2). The Saudi side looks structurally more sound.
  • Goals Bet: 'Both Teams to Score - Yes'. Al Duhail's attack is potent at home, and Al Ittihad is unlikely to fire a blank.
  • Key Factor: The hosts' defensive midfield performance. If they lose the second balls, Al Ittihad will dominate possession.

A pivotal clash in the AFC Champions League Elite group stage takes place at the Rashid Stadium in Dubai. Shabab Al Ahli hosts Qatar's Al Gharafa in a match that could define the group dynamics. The hosts are looking to solidify their position near the top using their formidable home advantage, while the visitors arrive with a potent attack, desperate to secure points and improve their shaky away record.

Date and Kick-off Time: November 24, 2025, 16:00 UTC (19:00 MSK).

Form Analysis and Tactical Preview

Shabab Al Ahli (Dubai) enters the match as the clear favorite. Under the guidance of Paulo Sousa, the team plays a pragmatic yet highly effective style of football. The 'Red Knights' remain unbeaten at home in the UAE Pro League. Their primary weapon is Sardar Azmoun, who has seamlessly integrated into a system that thrives on quick transitions. However, their vulnerability lies in defending against teams that switch play rapidly across the flanks.

Al Gharafa (Doha) is a team of extremes. The Qatari side boasts a star-studded attack featuring Yacine Brahimi and Joselu, players capable of turning a game on its head individually. Yet, the balance between defense and attack remains their Achilles' heel. In recent outings, Al Gharafa has scored freely but conceded just as generously. Their away form is particularly concerning, often marked by lapses in concentration during the second half.

Head-to-Head (H2H) History

Historical data favors the hosts. In their last 5 meetings (across all competitions), Shabab Al Ahli has secured 2 wins and 2 draws, with Al Gharafa managing only one victory. Notably, Al Gharafa has not won at the Rashid Stadium in over five years. Matches between these two are typically high-scoring affairs, with the average goal count exceeding 3.5 per game.

Shabab Al Ahli vs Al Gharafa Prediction

Bookmakers and analysts lean towards a home win, citing Shabab Al Ahli's superior defensive organization and home dominance. Al Gharafa will be forced to push forward, likely leaving spaces that the hosts' counter-attacking unit will exploit ruthlessly.

  • Likely Outcome: Shabab Al Ahli to Win (Home Win). Tactical discipline and home support should outweigh the visitors' individual flair.
  • Total Goals Bet: 'Over 3 Goals'. Both sides have elite attackers and questionable defenses, a recipe for goals.

Portugal U17 vs Brazil U17: Watch Live Stream Online - FIFA U-17 World Cup 24.11.2025

The evening session in Doha presents fans with a true footballing classic. The second semi-final of the FIFA U-17 World Cup sees Portugal clash with Brazil. This is a confrontation between the planet's two most prolific academies: European systematization and tactical flexibility versus South American improvisation and technique. The winner of this tie is widely considered the favorite to lift the trophy, making this match a 'hidden final.'

Date and Kick-off Time: November 24, 2025, 16:00 UTC (19:00 MSK).

Team Paths and Tactical Analysis

Portugal U17 has navigated the tournament with lethal composure. The 'Seleção das Quinas' has conceded only two goals in five games, demonstrating exemplary defensive organization. In the quarter-finals, the Portuguese tactically outclassed Germany (2-0), completely neutralizing the German attack. The team's main strengths are their rapid wingers and tempo control through midfield. They do not seek possession for its own sake, preferring vertical attacks upon interception.

Brazil U17 is pure attacking chaos. The reigning South American champions have scored 18 goals in 5 tournament matches, overwhelming opponents through individual brilliance. In the quarter-finals, the 'Seleção' engaged in a shootout with Argentina, winning a dramatic 4-3 encounter. Brazil operates with a 4-2-4 shape in the attacking phase, creating numerical overloads across the pitch. However, their commitment to offense often leaves vast spaces behind the defense, which the pragmatic Portuguese will undoubtedly look to exploit.

Head-to-Head (H2H) History

At the U17 level, these teams have met 6 times. The record is nearly balanced: 2 wins for Portugal, 3 wins for Brazil, and 1 draw. Their last meeting occurred in 2023 at a friendly tournament, ending in a 3-1 victory for Portugal. However, official World Cup knockout matches bring an entirely different level of pressure and motivation.

Portugal U17 vs Brazil U17 Prediction

Analysts expect one of the most entertaining matches of the tournament. Brazil does not know how to play defensively, while Portugal possesses the perfect tools to punish errors. The odds are split 50/50, where the outcome could be decided by a single set-piece or a moment of individual genius.

  • Likely Outcome: 'Both Teams to Score - Yes' and 'Over 2.5 Goals'. The attacking potential of both squads outweighs their defensive capabilities.
  • Value Bet: Draw in regular time. With stakes this high, teams might become cautious in the dying minutes.
  • Key Factor: The goalkeeper duel. With an abundance of chances expected, the keepers will likely be the protagonists of the match.

Tune into the Portugal vs Brazil live stream on tutsport.net and enjoy the future stars of world football!

Torino at home is a fortress. The team relies on man-to-man marking and aggressive pressing in the midfield. Against teams that like to possess the ball but lack physicality, Torino is particularly effective, disrupting their rhythm with tactical fouls.

Como, led by a coaching staff with Spanish influence (the Fabregas project), attempts to play football uncharacteristic of underdogs. They play out from the back and seek pockets of space. However, in away matches, this bravery is often punished. The 'Lariani' defense is vulnerable to set-pieces and rapid vertical attacks, which perfectly suits today's opponent's style.

Head-to-Head (H2H) Stats

In recent history, the teams have met rarely, but the historical advantage lies with Torino. The Turin side rarely loses to Como at home. Recent trends show that matches between these teams are rarely high-scoring — the hosts' pragmatism dictates the flow.

Expect a tough, gritty game with the hosts dominating the physical battles.

Al-Ahli vs Al Sharjah: Watch Live Stream Online - AFC Champions League Elite 24.11.2025

At the King Abdullah Sports City Stadium (the Radiant Jewel of Jeddah), Saudi giants Al-Ahli host UAE's Al Sharjah in the AFC Champions League Elite. This is a clash of polar opposite styles: the total dominance of the star-studded hosts versus the organized 'park the bus' tactics of the visitors. For Al-Ahli, this match is an opportunity to seal their knockout stage spot early, leveraging the deafening support of their home crowd.

Date and Kick-off Time: November 24, 2025, 18:15 UTC (21:15 MSK).

Current Form and Tactical Analysis

Under the guidance of Matthias Jaissle, Al-Ahli continues to display high-quality attacking football. The Jeddah-based team relies heavily on the individual brilliance of their attacking unit, spearheaded by Riyad Mahrez and Franck Kessié. In the domestic league, 'Al-Raqi' sits in the top three, and they remain unbeaten at home in the Champions League. However, their high defensive line often leads to vulnerabilities against rapid counter-attacks, as seen in the previous round against Iraq's Al-Shorta.

Al Sharjah arrives in Saudi Arabia with a clear game plan: suffer and wait for their chance. Head coach Cosmin Olăroiu is renowned for his pragmatism and ability to construct a deep defensive block against top-tier clubs. The Emirati side is comfortable conceding possession, averaging less than 40% of the ball against favorites. Their main threat comes from set-pieces and the pace of their wingers, who are capable of outrunning Al-Ahli's defenders on the break.

Physical fitness is at its peak for both teams in late November, though Al-Ahli's schedule has been more congested due to Saudi King's Cup fixtures. Al Sharjah has had two extra days of recovery, which could play a role in the second half. Nevertheless, the disparity in squad quality remains colossal, and the visitors will need to perform above their ceiling to take points away from Jeddah.

Head-to-Head History and Stats

Encounters between Saudi and Emirati clubs are always intense, but statistics favor the Kingdom's representatives. In head-to-head duels, Al-Ahli has won 3 of the last 4 home matches against Al Sharjah. The last time these teams met in the group stage two years ago, the match in Jeddah ended in a convincing 3-1 victory for the hosts.

Al Sharjah traditionally struggles on away trips to Saudi Arabia, conceding an average of 2 goals per game. The pressure factor of the King Abdullah stands often breaks the visitors' psychology within the first 20 minutes. However, Sharjah's defense has been tighter this season, conceding only 4 goals in 5 group stage rounds.

An interesting statistical trend: matches involving Al-Ahli at home frequently see a high number of corners. The hosts apply constant pressure, forcing opponents to clear the ball behind the goal line. For stats enthusiasts, this is a crucial marker when analyzing the game flow.

Al-Ahli vs Al Sharjah Prediction

Bookmakers unequivocally back Al-Ahli for the win. The caliber of players, the home venue, and attacking power make them clear favorites. Al Sharjah will attempt to stifle the game, but containing the hosts' attack for 90 minutes is nearly impossible. We are likely to see a home victory by a margin of 1-2 goals.

  • Likely Outcome: Al-Ahli to Win with Handicap (-1). The hosts need to bounce back from dropped points domestically, and the ACL is the perfect stage.
  • Goals Bet: 'Al-Ahli Individual Total Over 2.0'. The visitors' defense will eventually crack under sustained pressure.
  • Key Factor: Wing play. If Mahrez finds space, Al Sharjah will have no chance.

Tune into the Al-Ahli vs Al Sharjah live stream on tutsport.net and don't miss this spectacle of Asian football!

Espanyol vs Sevilla: Watch Live Stream Online - Match is Today, 24.11.2025

Attention! The match takes place tonight. The La Liga round concludes with a classic fixture at the RCDE Stadium. Catalan side Espanyol, desperately fighting for survival and stability, hosts Andalusian giants Sevilla. For the visitors, this season is an attempt to return to the elite of Spanish football after a series of setbacks. The hosts traditionally rely on their home fortress, where the 'Parakeets' are capable of pecking apart any favorite. The live stream on tutsport.net will show whose nerves hold up better on this Monday night.

Kick-off Time: Today, 20:00 UTC (23:00 MSK).

Immediate Match Preview

Espanyol plays pragmatic, sometimes 'dirty' football this season. The coaching staff realizes they lack the quality for an open game, so at home, they flood the midfield and tackle hard. The Catalans' main hopes lie in set-pieces and counter-attacks via fast wings. Their weakness is losing concentration in the final 15 minutes, which frequently costs them points.

Sevilla, under Garcia Pimienta, continues to seek a balance between possession and efficiency. The Andalusians boast a powerful attacking lineup (Lukebakio, Isaac Romero), but their defense regularly commits unforced errors. Away from home, Sevilla is inconsistent: they can produce a brilliant performance or collapse under pressure from an underdog. The key to success for the visitors today is quick ball control and converting chances in the first half.

Head-to-Head (H2H) Stats

Historically, Sevilla is a difficult opponent for Espanyol. The Andalusians have remained unbeaten against the 'Parakeets' in most recent meetings. Sevilla's last visit to the RCDE Stadium ended in a high-scoring shootout or a confident win. However, Espanyol regularly scores against the visitors from the south at home.

Prediction for Today's Match

Expect a nervous game with plenty of physical battles and cards. Espanyol won't let the visitors breathe, while Sevilla will try to win on quality.

  • Main Bet: Sevilla Double Chance and Under 3.5 Goals (X2 + Under 3.5). The visitors look superior on paper, but don't expect a goal fest.
  • Total: 'Under 2.5 Goals'. Monday night fixtures often see teams playing in economy mode.
  • Value Bet: Draw. Both teams match each other in their inconsistency; a point split would likely satisfy both managers.
